nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/desktop_docs_record.md — the handoff/state corpus, 2026-05-25 → 07-12. Source: the desktop machine's gitignored docs/handoff/ (6 files) and docs/state/ (14 files), 6,719 lines total, every file read in full, read-only. The source of the [DOC] entries in USER_CANON.md — ~150 recovered verbatim quotes and 80 labelled rulings

Why this corpus matters: it covers the exact window the two other records cannot reach. USER_CANON.md's laptop half starts 2026-07-06, and git_record.md's own G-2 says there is no commit on the decision dates — every decision in that fortnight happened in conversation and arrived pre-formed in one 750-line commit. These twenty documents ARE that conversation, written down within hours of it. They are agent-authored, but eleven carry an explicit "Canonical user-established facts" section separating what the user said from what the assistant proposed

The record's four labels: [USER-STATED] — a verbatim user quote appears in the source doc, or the doc records an explicit user ruling in a "Canonical user-established facts" / "Decisions made (user)" slot with attribution; [USER-STATED — paraphrase] — the ruling is attributed but the wording is the agent's; [AGENT-ASSERTED] — an assistant proposal, synthesis, recommendation or self-report, including anything in a working-hypotheses section and all agent-run measurements; [UNCLEAR] — attribution genuinely cannot be settled from the document

The discipline these docs make possible, and its limit. From 2026-06-09 onward each state doc opens with a section that exists precisely to stop agent output being read back as canon — 2026-06-09 §3: "Only things the user explicitly stated, confirmed, or corrected." Those sections are the highest-grade evidence in the corpus. But they are still an agent's report of a conversation, written by the same agent whose proposals they are separating themselves from. Three documents show that boundary failing and being caught: 2026-05-31 ("you have created something fucked up here" — five memory files written as "decided" from a pasted summary), 2026-06-11 §8 (the whole SemAxis axis/projection apparatus had leaked into docs and memory as if decided), and 2026-06-25 (the memories and DESIGN.md found to misrepresent the facet model)

Inventory, docs/handoff/ — the six frozen session handoffs. 1 2026-05-25 graph-rag-retrieval-redesign (144 lines): bake-at-index vs synthesize-at-query, the 4-layer recall→filter→rank→cap shape, the 7-factor scoreCypher named as the violation, tagger temp 0.3→0, SQL-agent replaces Lucene as the baseline. 2 2026-05-25 middle-layer-weight-redesign (175): three roles — indexing=math / interpreter=LLM / retriever=graph — five open product decisions, and the facet "weight AND direction" origin statement. 3 2026-05-25 artefact-audit-and-cleanup-plan (173): the live audit of herb-eval, with verified node/edge/tag counts, the three weight layers and their measured distributions, six real defects (23 unembedded tags, ~18% identifier pollution, dropped timestamps, years derived from tags, relevance_to_file mis-calibration, w_facet only categorical) and the doc-drift list. 4 2026-05-31 v2-artefact-rebuild-and-facet-design (108): the v2 pivot. 5 2026-06-03 v2-chunking-model-design (49). 6 2026-06-04 v2-chunk-cap-and-budget (47): the ~3000-token cap as the tagger's focus span, not an embedder limit, with calibration deferred

Inventory, docs/state/ — the fourteen dated state-transfer documents. 7 06-09 weight-production-measure-not-emit (170 lines). 8 06-11 v2-facet-carriers-and-build-gate (168): per-chunk phrase-tag nodes, the chunk description killed, the axis/projection machinery killed, and the design-before-build gate. 9 06-12 v2-graph-spine-and-literal-matching (158): the spine closed at Source→File→Chunk→Tag. 10 06-14 v2-facets-as-relevance-channels (160): the breakthrough, the mapping key finalized, the repo split, and the thesis recorded as done. 11 06-18 v3-eval-harness-herb-ragas (338): both scorers, and the birth of v3/. 12 06-23 v3-vector-arm-independence-comment-hygiene (306): arms share only the corpus on disk and the injected generator. 13 06-25 artefact-tag-facets-vs-routing (135). 14 06-25 artefact-facets-guide-link-and-content-profile (346) — the pivotal document, diagnosing "the hollowing". 15 06-25 v3-vector-eval-k-vs-topk-ragas-ops (326): RAGAS ONLY, and k vs top-k with k=50 justified by HERB's median-52 citation count. 16 06-28 artefact-build-deferred-and-next (646). 17 06-28 artefact-build-design-evolution (1,272) — the 123-turn conversation reconstructed with [tNN] citations, the single richest user-voice document in the corpus. 18 06-28 artefact-lean-graph-live-facets-build (1,530) — the code record. 19 07-01 artefact-pass2-dials-curve-relationships (463). 20 07-12 v3-current-state-and-artefact-v1-review (205)

The record's seven sections: 1 Inventory; 2 the chronological design record 2026-05-25 → 07-12; 3 direct user quotes recovered verbatim, by date — the source every [DOC] citation resolves into; 4 the cross-check against git_record.md's C-1 … C-18, using the verdict vocabulary CONFIRMS / REFUTES / EXPLAINS / PARTLY EXPLAINS / NEITHER; 5 specified in this period and never built, beyond what the git contradiction list already holds; 6 what this corpus settles from git_record.md Part 4; 7 caveats on the record. Standing: interpretation, second-hand, in the review pile, and never evidence under REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md
